extDescription.message: Sorts the Steam notes list by AppID and flags Early Access games on your wishlist — two toggleable modules in one extension.

moduleNotesDescription.message: On steamcommunity.com/notes/list: games with a resolvable AppID are moved above a separator line, everything else goes into a collapsible "Other notes" list below it.

moduleWishlistLabel.message: Flag Early Access on the wishlist

moduleWishlistDescription.message: On your Steam wishlist, turns the "Early Access" tag of already-released games into a link to the game's news page.

moduleWishlistSorterDescription.message: On your own wishlist in "Your rank" mode, adds a button that orders games by group: released, released in Early Access, then unreleased by how soon they come out. Your order inside the released groups is kept.

sorterButtonTooltip.message: Released → Early Access → full date → month → quarter → year → "Coming soon" → "To be announced"

sorterRestoreConfirm.message: Restore the wishlist order saved on $DATE$?

sorterConfirm.message: Games to move: $COUNT$. The current order will be saved so you can restore it. Continue?
